item.title: HIGGINSVILLE ADDS NEW FIRE CHIEF TO SAFETY BOARD
item.description: The Higginsville Board of Aldermen approved the appointment of Ashley Page to the city’s board of public safety. City Administrator Jeanette Dobson says Page recently became chief of the Higginsville Fire Protection District, which covers the city.

item.title: MINOR TRAIN DERAILMENT TEMPORARILY CLOSES OHIO STREET CROSSING
item.description: The Ohio Street Crossing has been temporarily closed due to a minor freight train derailment involving Union Pacific. The derailment occurred late Wednesday afternoon and no injuries have been reported. The incident involved a freight train only.
